Honestly, Jisung’s biggest strength as an artist is his ability to turn his inner world into music without losing its honesty. But THIS, this is my comfort content. I loved Han literally since the day one watching him on the survival show (I love all the guys, genuinely, but we all have our special person and for me it's Han). Honestly, I'm just listening this on repeat, his music is so comforting, so soothing. I just need the magic of being a STAY back in my life, honestly, I love this group so, so much ❤

text:
This video is an artistic masterpiece. This song literally brings me so much comfort and understanding of myself as a person.

I struggle sometimes (often) and I hate when people expect me to not be able to take care of it on my own because they think I'm weak for having certain difficulties.

I have dealt with this since I was a kid and I am 29 now. I have done it mostly alone. Yet so many think I can't do so many things because of it but I will  never allow them to make that my reality. I will do what I want/need no matter how anxious or overwhelmed I get. I still do it and I do it well!

Han literally showed me that being me is okay. 9 months ago I didn't even want to be on this earth but that day.. my cousin decided to show me stray kids and since then I have found myself, lost 12 kilos, gone out way more and even met a person from my country who loves them just as much as me. Now I'm even thinking about starting music, something I quit as 16 because of panic attacks and drug addiction.

I am still a stray, I'm just also a STAY now and it makes being a stray way easier and gives you a community and understanding. People can continue to tell me I don't act my age or don't fit in. They can shove me to the side and I won't mind because that's been my entire life. Han makes the music I relate to the most in stray kids and I have accepted parts of myself recently because of Han and my friends are there for me. I feel like I finally belong here on earth.

Thank you so much Han for this song and all the other songs you have made. I would loooooove to see more of this style of music from you! And OMG the hair and outfits in this video AND THE ANIMATION! I already know this song by heart and I sing it when I feel I'm about to have a panic attack! I love how much my life has changed in these 9 months! All thanks to 8 men on the other side of the world! LOVE FROM ICELAND!

Han-ah, I don't have enough words to describe how happy I feel. I've known Stray Kids since 2018, and I've grown up alongside you. Many STAYs say that you've saved us countless times, and it's true. I was away for quite a while, about two years or even more, during which I wasn't really keeping up with you, and I regret that. But I've come back to life, just like you say, and I'm so proud that you're here proving that it's possible to overcome your inner battles and even heal them through art, through amazing songs like this one.

I'm sure I'm not the only one who feels this way, but from the bottom of my heart, I want to wish all of you the very best. Happy birthday to our most precious Han Jisung.🐿️✨🎉
 It is truly hard to put into words how much you mean to me. Sometimes I find myself regretting that I didn’t find you earlier, but I am endlessly grateful that I know you now.

 Loving you and watching you grow has brought so much light into my life. More than anything in this world, I want to see you the happiest you can possibly be.

Looking back at everything you’ve been through—the intense anxiety you fought so bravely, the endless nights you spent in the studio doubting your own genius, and the heavy burdens you carried quietly behind your bright smile—it fills my heart with a profound sense of awe. You turned your deepest vulnerabilities, your fears, and your struggles into the most beautiful music. 

Every lyric you write feels like a warm embrace for those of us who have felt lonely or misunderstood. You took your pain and built a sanctuary for millions of people.I hope you know that you don't always have to be the loud, energetic mood-maker, and you never have to hide your shadows. 

The world loves Han for his incredible talent, his sharp rap, and his angelic vocals, but I love Jisung for his massive heart, his sensitivity, and his beautiful soul.Thank you for holding on, for choosing music, and for sharing your life with us. 

You are the pride of Stray Kids and the absolute joy of my life. I hope this year wraps you in the same warmth and comfort you have always given to me.

text:
it has been almost three years since i've been dealing with depression. I tried to overcome it in a million different ways but no matter how hard i tried, the world still felt so heavy and tiring. The reasons were multiple: my household, my family, my friends, my highschool, everyone's expectations on me... I used to be a top student when suddenly everything collapsed, every strength i had left, disappeared and i found myself alone, lost and with fear. All i could do was cry. Getting out of my bed was a torture, eating made me nauseous and even spending time with my few loved ones seemed impossible. The only thing that ever helped me was music. Music has always been there for me since i was born. It can make laugh, cry, smile... 
I remember one day i was scrolling through youtube meaningless, hoping to find something that could fix me for at least some seconds when i came across a Stray Kids music video. I had heard of them before because my younger cousin had been obsessed with them for a long time so i decided to give them a try. I´m gonna be honest, i initially didn't like it, so i stopped investigating.  I already knew some of their songs (the most famous ones) but i had no idea of the rest. 
Not long after, skz released "Do it" and i absolutely fell in love with it. I decided to give them another opportunity and i'm so glad i did. Apart from the music, YouTube started giving me recommendations like the amazing fan edits of skz. That's where i got to learn about skz as a group. I fell in love with the bond the members had and, suddenly, i found myself having actual fun watching them. Those videos, those songs started to bring a little light into my darkness. I started to listen to more music and i even developed a strong admiration for dancing. Little by little i began to find joy in the small things, even if it didn't last for long. 
I discovered stray kids at the beginning of my most difficult academical year. I cannot say that they gave me the strength to be at the top again. It was a really stressful year and my grades weren't exactly the best. But i can say proudly that i got through it and that i'm really close to finally say goodbye to this period of my life. 
I know things can´t get really good really fast, trust me, i´ve been in it three long years and i'm sure it's gonna take a while for me to fully recover. But, what i can assure is that you´ll get out. It's tough, really tough, it hurts, so much that you just want to give up on everything and disconnect from your reality. I'm not saying you have to be the best, i'm not saying you have to get your shit together, i'm not asking you to look at your reflexion an say words you don't mean. The only thing you have to do is to keep standing. No matter the storm, waterfall, hurricane, tsunami,  you keep standing. And if you fall, you get back up, don't smile, don't laugh, don't act like it's okay. Cry, let it out, but stand, don't let anyone nor anything throw you down. Stand and keep standing. For you, for me and for everyone that truly cares about you even if you can't see them. Keep standing until the day when standing no longer feels like an effort, but a necessity.

I don´t know if my story will reach someone one day and help them stand, but i know i wrote this to say one more thing:
Thank you, Stray Kids
Thank you, Han, Bang Chan, Seungmin, Hyunjin, Felix, Changbin, Lee Know, I.N
Thank you so much for helping me and STAY
Thank you for making us want to keep standing

It's like you possess all the talents in the world and overwhelm us with them. But I'm here for that!!!! I've been waiting to see HAN do a rock-sounding song, because I'm convinced that it complements his voice&presence the most. I'd say that I'm... Right with that? I'll have to admit that it took me awhile to get over my excitement... I even had to put my reaction to this release in words on a piece of paper dude, I was filled with joy and listened to it over and over again😭😭. Btw, this text will probably just bore anyone who reads it, but I just want to say that writing this comment was so hard for me. Not the actual writing (that too tbh), but putting it out there for strangers to read 😭. It's kind of embarrassing, but things like that make me REALLY nervous. I even wrote this down before actually typing it out.  But tbh, I feel like this is the least I can do. I'm so happy that he's happy. I think most han-stans feel this way, considering his past struggles with many mental issues- and health problems... Which is kind of natural and it really does happen to many people, for some more intense and for others less extreme. But it being natural and kinda human doesn't make the pain any less, really. Now, writing lyrics is so incredibly difficult to master... But in the end, it's worth looking at the paper! If going through all of that pain isn't enough, there you have him DESCRIBING it in a way that's incredibly difficult, and I'm not just talking about lyrics themselves but the melody, instrumentals and theatrical structure as well. They all complement each other so, so well and create all together a super beautiful, artistic masterpiece in the end, that people all around the world are allowed to witness for FREE. The least we could do is so appreciate and think about it, don't you think? We can all pick something up from this song and learn how to, possibly, express ourselves in an artistic way, if it just means thinking about how we feel our emotions and what we can do about them. So many people say that, and ME AS WELL, because I agree, but HAN, you're such an inspiration out there. To me the most important one. Seeing how people express themselves and feel about things is interesting to me and I sometimes like thinking about it, it's like learning how people are as people, and how similar or different they are from one another. I love seeing the "darker" sides of HAN, be it through songs or through looks. Actually, I prefer through songs, I don't want him going through dark things anymore... Because you never know about the outcome, until it happens. His way of feeling and showing things seem very extreme already, which kind of indicates that he's a human with a big heart, in my opinion. Having more intense emotions/feelings is difficult to manage and imo is even more of a challenge to express. I'm pretty sure that he's gone through so many slumps by now... Considering the fact that he even wrote a song named by that!! I really do feel like, breaking out of a suffocating and hard-to-manage shell, can and normally WILL make you stronger. So emotions are the most important factor when it comes to expressing yourself musically, from my view. It's beautiful to witness, but also sad to think about... When you really think about it. When you read the translations of his lyrics. But then you remember that he was able to share all of that due to him not being in that phase anymore... At least I hope so. Not only is he (probably) talking to himself/sharing his thoughts when writing lyrics, but he really IS influencing many and MANY people to hear his advices. Which DO save lives. Be it physically or mentally. The fact that he's been able to break out of these many shells so many times, is proof that everyone can do that as well, I think. It really is motivating, and I found his last song to truly be a "wake-up-call!". He is very good with facial expressions and shows us all sorts of exhausted, stressed out, nervous and hopeless scenes, wherein his face carries all sorts of emotions, if you know what I mean! I don't necessarily think that there's a perfect time or moment to release a song, people can be suffering in a few years and find the song at that time to help them out! It's probably just that many people are hurting for a longer time, which is supposedly why they believe the song arrived at the perfect time, if you ask me! But of course, there are some days worse than the others. And some people just seen to be lucky enough to have these kind of songs brought to them on a specifically unlucky day. I am really thankful for not going thru a hard time momentarily, but that might change in the future. Which I think I'll be able to survive with your songs, HAN. I seriously couldn't even listen to the first line of the song without completely crashing out. It's just THAT good. And I mean everything, from the actual sentence to the way he sang it. It's impossible to put in words, I think there are just very intense feelings you can't explain. This song is really hope-giving and I still can't get over the fact that you can share your pain/scars so freely and beautifully. Maybe freely isn't correct here, it probably took you some time and courage. But this song has so much energy and motivation to it that it's contagious. The optimism affected me and now I'm a happier human being. Hehe. Also, I don't even wanna get started about his looks in this MV, because I fear that I won't stop talking. You'll already know what I mean TwT. The acting in this MV is superior as well. Last but not least, I really wanna say thank you for all your efforts. Seriously, all of this might seem like sugarcoating, but it really is just the way I feel. And I'm pretty sure that I'm not the only one. I hope, you can take some joy out of all the compliments you get and see that you truly deserve it. No- even more than that. It's just that there's not much more I can do... I only wish the best for you and everyone who is reading this, I'm really, really excited to see what you (along with the other members of stray kids) will offer us in the future. text:
Is it just me, or do Stray Kids still seem like babies in my eyes? 😭 Not in a bad way at all! I mean, for example, EXO seems so mature and serious to me, but when I look at Stray Kids, I still see the same boys I saw when they were just starting out. 
 
And I don't mean that they haven't grown or matured—they obviously have, especially with how much they've accomplished. I mean that their core personalities haven't changed. They're still so humble, and their cute and funny personalities that I loved from the beginning are still there, which honestly makes me love them even more. 
 
Like, how do you become THIS successful and achieve so much, but still keep that same humility and those same qualities that made people love you when you debuted? 😭 
 
I'm not talking about their talent at all, because talent-wise, they have grown SO much and they're just incredible. I mean their personalities. Their success hasn't changed the kind of people they are, and I think that's such a beautiful thing.

text: Han Jisung, eres un artista extraordinario, eres la persona más maravillosa que jamás haya conocido en la vida. Tienes simplemente algo que hace que las cosas dejen de ser aburridas y adquieran su todo de colores brillantes. Envidia? Creo que es la mejor forma de explicarlo porque ni yo mismo lo entiendo. Cuando te veo tener éxito me siento tan feliz por ti… y a la vez me odio un poquito más por no ser como tú, porque la verdad es que amo todo de ti y odio todo de mi. Y me siento incluso más patetico y estúpido porque al escuchar esta canción por primera vez yo no me sentí con fuerzas…. Digamos que hice algo muy malo para mi, y eso me hace sentir peor, y no sé cómo cambiarlo porque si hay algo que odie más que ser yo es sentir ese sentimiento de envidia que no quiero sentir. Me esforzaré más para quitarme este desagradable sentimiento y llegar a ser la persona que quiero ser, gracias por existir y hacerme darme cuenta de esto😭💙

text: Hello!! Now this might seem a little random or perhaps unnecessary, but I kind of wanna talk about this song, as a hanpop-sucker. I think that I couldn't retain myself. I got really interested in rock concepts lately, but not really outside of the k/j-genre, if you know what I mean. First, I want to really tell you how much I appreciate this song, your efforts and the guts to show the world such lyrics, I can't say for sure, but I don't think it was easy at ALL. I was SHOCKED and FLABBERGASTED when I saw the video that skz had uploaded with the title HAN-"back to life" SKZ-PLAYER. You don't know how much I was filled with joy, plus seeing that it was 4+ minutes long. IT'S NOT EVEN MY BIRTHDAY!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH, ACTUALLY. Friday comebacks are usually my favorites, I don't think I need to explain that. It's like- nice, weekend now. OH WOW, A SONG I CAN THINK ABOUT FOR THE NEXT TWI DAYS, AND THAT IN PEACE!!!!🤘 I'm seriously taken aback by all those emotional elements, your naturally rock-sounding voice and especially the way those lyrics were written... By a non-native English speaker. I am not a native speaker as well, which ADDS to the impression. That's more than just impressive... It's SHOCKING AND SCARY, IF I'M BEING HONEST. It's like you possess all the talents in the world and overwhelm us with them. But I'm here for that!!!! I've been waiting to see HAN do a rock-sounding song, because I'm convinced that it complements his voice&presence the most. I'd say that I'm... Right with that? I'll have to admit that it took me awhile to get over my excitement... I even had to put my reaction to this release in words on a piece of paper dude, I was filled with joy and listened to it over and over again😭😭. Btw, this text will probably just bore anyone who reads it, but I just want to say that writing this comment was so hard for me. Not the actual writing (that too tbh), but putting it out there for strangers to read 😭. It's kind of embarrassing, but things like that make me REALLY nervous. I even wrote this down before actually typing it out.  But tbh, I feel like this is the least I can do. I'm so happy that he's happy. I think most han-stans feel this way, considering his past struggles with many mental issues- and health problems... Which is kind of natural and it really does happen to many people, for some more intense and for others less extreme. But it being natural and kinda human doesn't make the pain any less, really. Now, writing lyrics is so incredibly difficult to master... But in the end, it's worth looking at the paper! If going through all of that pain isn't enough, there you have him DESCRIBING it in a way that's incredibly difficult, and I'm not just talking about lyrics themselves but the melody, instrumentals and theatrical structure as well. They all complement each other so, so well and create all together a super beautiful, artistic masterpiece in the end, that people all around the world are allowed to witness for FREE. The least we could do is so appreciate and think about it, don't you think? We can all pick something up from this song and learn how to, possibly, express ourselves in an artistic way, if it just means thinking about how we feel our emotions and what we can do about them. So many people say that, and ME AS WELL, because I agree, but HAN, you're such an inspiration out there. To me the most important one. Seeing how people express themselves and feel about things is interesting to me and I sometimes like thinking about it, it's like learning how people are as people, and how similar or different they are from one another. I love seeing the "darker" sides of HAN, be it through songs or through looks. Actually, I prefer through songs, I don't want him going through dark things anymore... Because you never know about the outcome, until it happens. His way of feeling and showing things seem very extreme already, which kind of indicates that he's a human with a big heart, in my opinion. Having more intense emotions/feelings is difficult to manage and imo is even more of a challenge to express. I'm pretty sure that he's gone through so many slumps by now... Considering the fact that he even wrote a song named by that!! I really do feel like, breaking out of a suffocating and hard-to-manage shell, can and normally WILL make you stronger. So emotions are the most important factor when it comes to expressing yourself musically, from my view. It's beautiful to witness, but also sad to think about... When you really think about it. When you read the translations of his lyrics. But then you remember that he was able to share all of that due to him not being in that phase anymore... At least I hope so. Not only is he (probably) talking to himself/sharing his thoughts when writing lyrics, but he really IS influencing many and MANY people to hear his advices. Which DO save lives. Be it physically or mentally. The fact that he's been able to break out of these many shells so many times, is proof that everyone can do that as well, I think. It really is motivating, and I found his last song to truly be a "wake-up-call!". He is very good with facial expressions and shows us all sorts of exhausted, stressed out, nervous and hopeless scenes, wherein his face carries all sorts of emotions, if you know what I mean! I don't necessarily think that there's a perfect time or moment to release a song, people can be suffering in a few years and find the song at that time to help them out! It's probably just that many people are hurting for a longer time, which is supposedly why they believe the song arrived at the perfect time, if you ask me! But of course, there are some days worse than the others. And some people just seen to be lucky enough to have these kind of songs brought to them on a specifically unlucky day. I am really thankful for not going thru a hard time momentarily, but that might change in the future. Which I think I'll be able to survive with your songs, HAN. It's impossible to put in words, I think there are just very intense feelings you can't explain. This song is really hope-giving and I still can't get over the fact that you can share your pain/scars so freely and beautifully. Maybe freely isn't correct here, it probably took you some time and courage. But this song has so much energy and motivation to it that it's contagious. You'll already know what I mean TwT. The acting in this MV is superior as well. Last but not least, I really wanna say thank you for all your efforts. Seriously, all of this might seem like sugarcoating, but it really is just the way I feel. And I'm pretty sure that I'm not the only one. I hope, you can take some joy out of all the compliments you get and see that you truly deserve it. No- even more than that. It's just that there's not much more I can do... I only wish the best for you and everyone who is reading this, I'm really, really excited to see what you (along with the other members of stray kids) will offer us in the future. So I listened to it while watching the mountains outside the window glowing in the sunset light, listened to it on my way home, while walking my dog, while taking a shower, and I’m even listening to it right now before going to sleep.

Han, I’m truly amazed by you, your artistry, and your sound. I’m so deeply in love with your new song, it’s actually insane.
I even cried because of how beautiful this song, the MV, and especially your voice are. Your voice is so versatile and emotional that it gives me goosebumps every time.
And your English sounds absolutely amazing too.

Thank you so much, Jisung.
“Back to Life” unexpectedly became my healing and inspiration ❤️‍🩹

It seems like living the truth is much easier for him than lying or creating the illusion of someone he's not.  And I love him for this strength to be himself, because only a strong person in his profession can admit their weaknesses. Or their right to not be perfect. This is what makes my love for Jisung stronger every time. My little brave mouse, you are so amazing. Your ability to rise like a phoenix from the ashes is so motivating, and your music is inspiring. Please never try to make others happy, because you are the main character in your life. Continue to strive for your own happiness time and time again. text:
Amar o Han é como gostar de uma estrela que nunca vai cair do céu.
Ele brilha em uma distância segura, inalcançável, e mesmo assim aquece.
A voz dele chega até mim atravessando fones de ouvido, telas, traduções imperfeitas e ainda assim consegue entender partes de mim que ninguém vê.
Eu o amo nesse lugar impossível onde não há encontros, nem promessas.
Amo o jeito que ele transforma sentimentos em música, como se soubesse exatamente onde dói.
Amo o sorriso que aparece rápido e some rápido, como se fosse tímido demais para ficar.
Amo até o fato de nunca o conhecer, porque isso faz desse amor algo puro, sem cobranças, sem finais felizes inventados.
Dói saber que ele nunca vai saber meu nome. Que meus dias seguem aqui enquanto a vida dele acontece do outro lado do mundo.
Mas existe uma beleza triste nisso: ele não precisa me ver para me salvar em momentos pequenos, silenciosos, quando uma música basta.
Talvez amar assim seja aceitar a distância. Guardar o sentimento como quem guarda uma carta que nunca será enviada.
E mesmo sabendo que nunca vou vê-lo, continuo grata - porque, por algum motivo, ele esteve presente quando eu precisei, mesmo sem saber.

EU TE AMO!
